text:
maria: Quick question — thinking about continuous-batcher placement + queue shape. Does it make sense to run per-tenant microqueues for tiny requests vs a shared slab with eviction at request vs token-level? We keep hitting tail latency when small requests mix with big ones.
kevin: Throughput vs fairness trade. Microqueues reduce interference but increase fragmentation and complicate packing. Shared slab is denser but needs smarter eviction.
anna: Also consider KV-cache locality — per-tenant lanes make pinning easier and preserve warmups.
josh: Observed noisy-tenant tiny reqs starve batch formation. My idea: hybrid — small fast-lane microqueues for <=128-token requests, shared slab for others.
sophie: Eviction model? I prefer credit-based soft eviction + backpressure signals to router so clients can fallback.
maria: Rough enqueue flow I sketched:
```
if (fastlane.accepts(req)) enqueue_fastlane(req)
else if (slab.has_space()) enqueue_slab(req)
else {
  candidate = select_preemptable(slab, req.priority, req.deadline)
  if (candidate) preempt(candidate)
  else route_to_slowpath(req)
}
```
Knobs: fastlane-size, slab-headroom, preempt-window, eviction-priority-order.
carol: Preemption costs: partial KV warmups and wasted GPU cycles. Prefer draining or keep 8-10% reserved headroom to avoid frequent preempts.
kevin: Telemetry needs: per-tenant enqueues/drops, preempt counts, preempt latency penalty, slab occupancy by token-count, backpressure reason codes. Will help tune headroom.
josh: Add automatic model-fallback: if preempted / slowpath, try quantized fallback to preserve SLA.
sophie: Streaming responses hold slots long. Either token-account them separately or route to dedicated streaming pool so they don't block batch windows.
maria: Proposed experiment actions: 1) hybrid slab with fast-lane threshold + 8% reserved headroom; 2) credit-based soft-eviction (preempt only if candidate.priority < incoming.priority && candidate.age > preempt_window); 3) router handshake includes deadline_hint + model_fallback flag; 4) add eviction/backpressure telemetry + reason codes.
deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4721 'hybrid-slab-eviction-experiment' and linked RFC PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/infer/pulls/1234 :white_check_mark: 
kevin: Can we run sims with last-quarter traces (small/burst heavy, mixed long/short) to validate before landing?
maria: Yes, I'll run sim sweeps next week and post results here. Thanks all :pray:
